A [[Gender/Legends|male]] worked as the '''manager''' of [[Dreshdae Spaceport]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. When the former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] group landed on Korriban in the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]'', the spaceport manager recognized Revan as a Jedi and imposed a 25 [[Credit chip/Legends|credit]] docking fee.
